purpose: Define Org_a as admissible organization over distinction-generating participation fields, using vertical-bar closure, grouped-bar closure, and orientation preservation as explicit prerequisites.

definition.name: Admissible Organization Operator
definition.reading: Org_a(G) denotes a legally preserved organization of admissible distinction participation over a typed participation graph G.

requires: exists o in O(G) such that Adm_O(G,o)

axioms.name: Inventory Preservation
axioms.statement: Legal transformations under Org_a must preserve the admissible distinction inventory of G.
axioms.candidate_form: Inv_D(G) = Inv_D(G') under G iff_R G'
axioms.meaning: The organization may deform, regroup, or transform only if the participating distinction inventory remains traceable.

axioms.name: Admissibility Conservation
axioms.statement: Every legal transformation under Org_a must preserve admissibility of the organized participation field.
axioms.candidate_form: Org_a(G) and G iff_R G' implies Adm_a(G')
axioms.meaning: No organization remains legal if transformation causes its distinction participation to fall below epsilon_a or violate typed participation.

axioms.name: Topological Consistency
axioms.statement: Legal transformations under Org_a must preserve orientation-consistent participation structure.
axioms.candidate_form: Org_a(G) and G iff_R G' implies G ≃_O G'
axioms.meaning: The organization is preserved through admissible relational structure, not by visual shape or object identity.

derived_closure_candidate.candidate_formula: Adm_Org(G) := Adm_|^G(G) ∧ ∃o∈O(G) Adm_O(G,o) ∧ Eval_D^G(G) ∧ D_G(G)>epsilon_a ∧ InvPres_D(G) ∧ AdmCons_a(G) ∧ TopCons_O(G)
derived_closure_candidate.interpretation: An Org_a expression is admissibly closed only when grouped participation, orientation, distinction evaluation, inventory preservation, admissibility conservation, and topological consistency all hold.

relationship_to_D.statement: Org_a does not create distinction from nothing; it organizes already evaluable admissible distinction participation.

relationship_to_iff_R.statement: iff_R supplies the admissible preservation relation under which Org_a transformations are judged.
relationship_to_iff_R.candidate_rule: G iff_R G' is legal for Org_a only when inventory, admissibility, and orientation-consistent topology are preserved.

relationship_to_Sigma_D.statement: Sigma_D can now be drafted as an equivalence class or signature of Org_a-closed distinction organizations.
relationship_to_Sigma_D.warning: Sigma_D should not be defined by object identity, scalar D value, or projection-domain sameness.

must_state: Org_a organizes admissible distinction participation; it does not collect objects.
Org_a requires grouped bar closure and orientation preservation.
Inventory Preservation, Admissibility Conservation, and Topological Consistency are the candidate axioms.
These axioms are definition candidates until derived or qualified from D(A|B)>epsilon_a and iff_R.
Sigma_D depends on Org_a and should not be closed before Org_a qualification.

validation_requirements: No economics debt may be marked fully closed by this patch alone.
Sigma_D moves to ready-for-definition-pass only after Org_a candidate is registered.
Org_a must be tagged as candidate, not theorem.
forbidden_claims: Org_a axioms are fully proven by this patch.
Inventory preservation means object identity preservation.
Topological consistency means visual shape preservation.

recommended_next_patch.goal: Define Sigma_D admissible equivalence criteria using Org_a closure, iff_R preservation, and orientation equivalence.
